# source: amssymb.sty v3.01 (2013/01/14): every symbol command the file
# declares (\DeclareMathSymbol, and the aliases it makes with \global\let),
# one row each, in file order — the commands amsfndoc's symbol tables
# document. An impl row sets the scalar unicode-math's table gives the
# command (LeanTex/Core/MathSymData.lean, generated from the two files by
# scripts/gen-mathsym-data.lean). The glyph is the math face's: a scalar the
# face lacks is named on the page (W0009 when a fallback face sets it, E0405
# when none can). A refused row has no scalar of its own in unicode-math;
# the line above it names the glyph that is missing.
